title: A heartbeat Hackatime refused
description: The body HackatimeController#handle_heartbeat gives a heartbeat HeartbeatIngest couldn't take: error is the exception's message and type its class (hackatime_controller.rb lines 229-238). A bulk POST answers [this body, 422] in that heartbeat's place, and a single POST answers this body with 422. A time that isn't epoch seconds, or a scaled form of them, gets an InvalidHeartbeatTime (heartbeat_ingest.rb lines 364-395), and so does an entry of a bulk array that isn't an object, which reaches HeartbeatIngest as nothing (hackatime_controller.rb lines 284-299).

type.description: The Ruby class of the exception.

examples.error: time must be a Unix epoch timestamp
time must be Unix epoch seconds between 1000000000 and 1999999999
